parsed.degree_signal: Optional: Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in (Wirtschafts-) Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung sind von Vorteil.
parsed.notes:
The title explicitly asks for full-stack development; the requirements section also explicitly names software engineering and frontend development.
Cloud Foundry is nice_to_have because of 'idealerweise'; DDD, BDD and Arc42 are required examples. All four lack taxonomy entries.
DDD, BDD and Arc42 are examples for one architecture-methods ask, but cannot receive skill-id alternative groups because they are unmapped. Copilot and Agentic Coding do not create a group: Agentic Coding maps to the broad AI developer tooling criterion.
MCP, container technologies, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, MongoDB and PostgreSQL appear only in responsibilities and are excluded.
The comparable vocational qualification is read literally as an accepted alternative qualification, making degree_or_equivalent true.
The general encouragement to apply without every qualification does not make the requirements optional.
